'''D516''' was a menacing [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] distinguished by its treaded movement system. Produced by Sienar Technologies during the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the D516 model was equipped with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] carbine and needler gun, in addition to its heavy armor plating. Its sophisticated sensor systems employed infrared technology that allowed the droid to effectively target organic beings.
